why_it_matters: the choice FLIPS the headline verdict for the two coarsest runs
with_all: all three PASS (|rho-1| = 0.062 / 0.202 / 0.183) -> no crossing in range
the_subtlety: `slab_local` means 'own-family cells on a wall that HAS a hold-out slab', and wall_has_slab is decided by the FROZEN p3_2b HOLDOUT_SLABS = {west, north}. P3-2d has no slab at all -- its hold-out is the midpoint set -- so `slab_local` here is simply 'west and north cells', an arbitrary half of the walls inherited from a different experiment's design. `all` is every own-family cell, which is what 'no distinguished wall' should mean.
tension_with_A1: The A1 publication policy says `all` is diagnostic-only and must never be the published rho. That policy was written for P3-2b/P3-2c, where slab_local WAS the gated quantity because a slab existed. Applying it unchanged to P3-2d would gate on an arbitrary wall subset; overriding it silently would breach a guard that exists precisely to stop rho-shopping. Neither is mine to decide unilaterally.
position: I am NOT choosing. Both are reported side by side, the verdict is reported under BOTH, and the second seed is launched at the G020/G030 bracket because that pair is the crossing under slab_local and the closest approach under `all`.
